$releaseOnlyComment: Engine-internal release tooling. Overrides engineOwnedPaths (which globs scripts/**): these paths are NEVER distributed to formulacms-starter nor synced to forks — the slice ship-list + report command that curate which slices ship. Their presence is also the engine-vs-starter signal for the /admin/slices 'Ship to starter' toggle, so shipping them would surface engine-only tooling in a fork.
$pathsComment: engineOwnedPaths: expect these to fast-forward from upstream on sync; local edits there are upstream-port candidates (playbook step 10). ownerOwnedPaths: the fork's own surface — sync must never clobber these (slice descriptors/renderers a fork authored, its tokens, its assets). Paths in both lists (slice registry files) resolve per the playbook's conflict classes. releaseOnlyPaths takes precedence over engineOwnedPaths: a path it matches is engine-local and excluded from distribution even when an engineOwnedPaths glob (e.g. scripts/**) also matches it.
